title: Card-paid arrival and hotel-to-hotel price taken from a client-chosen region, not from the hotel booked
description: create-booking prices an airport arrival from the routes row of the client-supplied dropoff region. The hotel name is only shape-checked, so an anonymous booker can pick the cheapest region, type a hotel in a pricier region, and pay the cheaper tariff by card.
root_cause: No server-side relation between the free-text hotel name and the dropoff region; resolveHotelRegion is applied only to the pickup hotel on airport-return and hotel-to-hotel pickup.
intended_behavior: The recorded price_eur is the tariff of the region the hotel is actually in; mismatches are rejected or sent to a manual quote.

trace.description: dropoff_location read from the payload and only checked for presence
returns the client dropoff region as the tariff region for arrivals
routes row looked up by the client region; hotel name never resolved
card allowed whenever price > 0 and no operator quote flag; price stored and charged

evidence.description: dropoff hotel name validated only by isValidHotelName (length and letters)
hotel-to-hotel dropoffRegion is the client dropoff_location

conditions.description: None: the anon key is public in the bundle
Hotel must be in a pricier region than the chosen one

payloads: dropoff_location = cheapest region; hotel_name = name of a hotel in a pricier region; payment_method = card
instructions: Static trace only: no target code was executed.
POST the payload to create-booking with the public anon key.
Complete the iyzico checkout for the returned booking.
execution.observed_result: Source shows price_eur is read from the cheaper region row and the callback marks the booking paid at that amount; the operator email lists the real hotel and the region without a mismatch flag.

remediation.strategy: In create-booking, resolve the arrival and hotel-to-hotel destination hotel with resolveHotelRegion; reject when it differs from the client region and force the operator-quote path (no card) when the hotel is not in the index. Add a region/mismatch line to the operator email. Add vitest cases for transfer-price.

likelihood.reason: Needs a direct API call and knowledge of tariffs; no auth required.

impact.reason: Bounded revenue loss per booking (tariff difference); no data exposure; operator can notice by eye.

confidence.reason: Hunter and a fresh verifier traced the same path; resolveHotelRegion looseness and live behaviour were not exercised.
